name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A trigger and its accessible description, always linked by aria-describedby so the text reaches assistive technology whether or not it is shown. Quiet is a plain small label; warm hand-letters it; playful adds a pencil leader line. Without JavaScript, CSS alone reveals it by opacity on hover and focus. With JavaScript it becomes a popover (hint where understood, else manual), positioned above the trigger and flipped below when there is little room, by a pure, tested placement().

budget.reason: Decision 0005: 12 KB of behaviour plus 8 KB for each of three skins. Today about 7.3 KB: behaviour (tooltip.js + tooltip.core.js) 6.6 KB; skins quiet, warm and playful are each a no-op mount (about 0.2 KB each), because the look is entirely in tooltip.css keyed off [data-skin]/[data-open]/[data-above].
